package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "sync/atomic"
    "example.invalid/jsoncheckpoint/dispatch"
)

func semantics() {
    cases := []struct{ data string; want bool }{
        {`null`, true}, {`{"a":[true,1,"x\\u0041"]}`, true},
        {`[1,2,]`, false}, {`"unterminated`, false}, {`{"x":}`, false},
        {`  [false, null, -1.25e+2]  `, true}, {"\"bad\nstring\"", false},
    }
    for _, test := range cases {
        if got := json.Valid([]byte(test.data)); got != test.want { panic("json.Valid changed") }
    }
    fmt.Println("semantics=ok")
}

func main() {
    if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "semantics" { dispatch.Enable(); semantics(); return }
    data := append([]byte{'"'}, bytes.Repeat([]byte{'a'}, 2_000_000)...)
    data = append(data, '"')
    if !json.Valid([]byte("0")) { panic("warm scanner") }
    var ran atomic.Bool
    if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "alone" {
        dispatch.Enable()
    } else {
        start, ready := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
        go func() { close(ready); <-start; ran.Store(true) }()
        <-ready
        dispatch.Enable()
        close(start)
    }
    before := dispatch.Count()
    valid := json.Valid(data)
    sibling, yields := ran.Load(), dispatch.Count()-before
    if !valid { panic("json.Valid result") }
    fmt.Printf("sibling=%t valid=%t yields=%d\n", sibling, valid, yields)
}
